In this paper, we describe ALMA observations of a statically significant sample of protostars in the Orion molecular cloud. Their location in common puts them at a similar distance ( ∼ 400 pc) and in a similar environment, minimizing the effects of environmental differences on the observed parameters.
Here, we combined data from three configurations (TM1, TM2, and ACA) to improve the sensitivity of the line cubes.
In brief, we generated 1.3 mm continuum images using low-resolution ACA observations of typical beam size 7 ′′ . 6 × 4 ′′ . 1 to probe large-scale envelope emission.
